rawFindings.title: Object keys with a non-callable toString now make v1 decoding throw
rawFindings.explanation: This added condition passes every decoded key to `RegExp.test`, which coerces the key to a string. A valid Hessian map can use an object/map as a key, and that decoded object can contain a data property named `toString` (for example `{ toString: 'x' }`). Such an object cannot be converted with the normal property-key coercion, so decoding throws `TypeError: Cannot convert object to primitive value` before the entry can be stored in `$map` or skipped. rawFindings.suggestion: Do not coerce arbitrary object keys in the regex check; either restore the string/number guard for plain object assignment, or derive a safe property name for object keys with `Object.prototype.toString.call(key)` before testing/assigning.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Decoding a Hessian v1 map whose key is a nested object/map with field `toString` set to a string and whose value is `1` now throws a TypeError instead of decoding the map entry/preserving it in `$map`.

rawFindings.title: Object keys with a non-callable toString now make v2 map decoding throw
rawFindings.explanation: This unconditional property assignment coerces every decoded map key to a JavaScript property name. For a valid Hessian map with an object key whose decoded shape includes a non-function `toString` property, that coercion throws `TypeError: Cannot convert object to primitive value`, so decoding aborts before the key can be preserved in the non-enumerable ES6 `$map`. The removed type guard avoided this coercion for non-primitive keys.
rawFindings.suggestion: Avoid direct property-key coercion for arbitrary object keys; restore the primitive-only assignment and rely on `$map`, or convert object keys with a safe fallback such as `Object.prototype.toString.call(k)` before assigning.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Decoding a Hessian v2 untyped map containing a nested map/object key like `{ toString: 'x' }` and any value now throws a TypeError at `map[k] = v` instead of returning the decoded map with the entry preserved in `$map`.
